render event_saved_match_values.bind_some sr=0x41000000 cfg k=3 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9]
render event_saved_match_values.bind_some sr=0x41000000 cfg k=0 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9]
render event_saved_match_values.bind_twin sr=0x41000000 cfg k=3 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9]
@ an inner match on a binding of a match chosen by ^name counts too
render event_saved_match_values.inner_match sr=0x41000000 cfg k=5 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9]
render event_saved_match_values.inner_match sr=0x41000000 cfg k=0 in x=[1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9]
@ a part that reads no binding, and a ^name in the delay of the scrutinee, are the value where they are written
